output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS discounted_orders FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.discount_amount > 0
output.explanation: Counts orders with an order date in 2025 and a discount amount above zero. All statuses are included, as requested, so there is no revenue filter.
